Play Deadzone: Rogue now on Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/deadzone-rogue-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01 

Step into a forsaken space station overrun with endless biomechanical enemies, where every run is a fight for survival. In Deadzone: Rogue, you will explore shifting corridors, scavenge powerful experimental weapons and augments, and battle swarms that evolve with every encounter. Play solo or team up with friends in co-op in this exciting roguelite FPS. Can you conquer the ship and survive the Deadzone?
